page.title: Add product
page.subtitle: Enter the new product details. Each field includes guidance on what to write.

form.serverNoId: Server did not return a product ID
form.visibleOnSite: Product #{{id}} is visible on the customer site (clientActive: true).

section.label: Which section should the product appear in?
section.hint: On the customer site, the product appears under this section. Only one section can be selected.

mainInfo.title: Basic information
mainInfo.titleNamesRowHint: Enter the product name in both languages — it is shown automatically based on the site language.
mainInfo.pricingRowHint: Current sale price is required. Original price is only needed when there is a discount.
mainInfo.discountRowHint: If there is a discount, enter the text shown on the product card.

media.title: Video and main image
media.intro: The main appearance on the product card. A main image is always required — this is the product's general face. It is kept even when colors are added.
media.videoHint: Optional. A short video shown on the product page.
media.videoUploadHint: Click to choose from phone or computer
media.mainImageHint: Required. The main image in the catalog and on the product page — shown even without a color selection.
media.mainImageUploadHint: The single best photo of the product
media.thumbnailsHint: For products without color selection, the gallery comes from here. The first image appears after the main image.
media.colorsNote: Colors added — gallery images are temporarily hidden. Upload images for each color in the color block.
media.colorsNoteSaved: Previously entered {{count}} gallery images are preserved — they reappear if all colors are removed.

stock.title: Product stock (excluding colors)
stock.hiddenNote: Colors added — stock is filled in each color card. External stock fields are hidden; previous data is restored if colors are removed.
stock.intro: If the product is single-color or has no color selection, enter stock here. You can fill sizeStock, modelStock, and storageStock at the same time — for example model and storage variants for phones.
stock.sizeStockDesc: For clothing and sized products. Price is taken from the general price field in basic information.
stock.quantityHint: How many units of this size are available.
stock.modelStockDesc: For phones and products sold by model name. Each row has model, quantity, and prices.
stock.modelStockEmpty: No model rows. Click «Add more» — e.g. S20, S24 ULTRA.
stock.modelQuantityHint: How many units of this model are available.
stock.originalPriceHint: Strikethrough old price if there is a discount.
stock.storageStockDesc: For products sold by storage capacity. e.g. 12/256 or 8/128. Can be used together with modelStock.
stock.storageStockEmpty: No storage rows. Click «Add more» — e.g. 12/256, 8/128.
stock.storageQuantityHint: How many units of this storage variant are available.
stock.storagePriceHint: Sale price for this storage variant.

classification.title: Product category and classification
classification.masterCategoryHint: Select which main category the product belongs to.
classification.productTypeHint: Select which type the product belongs to.
classification.countryCodeLabel: Which country is the product from?
classification.countryCodeHint: Indicates which country the product belongs to and ships from to the customer.
classification.productCountryHint: Indicates which country the product was manufactured in.
classification.brandHint: Select which brand the product belongs to.
classification.countriesCategoryHint: Select which country category the product matches.

details.title: Weight and labels
details.weightHint: Enter product weight in grams. e.g.: 200, 700.
details.labelsHint: Select the labels you need. Text, icon, and colors are applied automatically. For discount, only enter the percentage.
details.chegirmaPercentHint: e.g.: if you enter 70, the label text becomes "Discount 70%" automatically.

chegirma.title: Discount
chegirma.hint: Only the percentage is entered manually. Text and animation are automatic.

original.title: Original
original.hint: Text, icon, and color are applied automatically.

superNarx.title: Super price
superNarx.hint: Text, icon, and color are applied automatically.

description.title: Product description
description.sectionHeadingHint: This heading is fixed — the about section on the customer site appears under this name.
description.infoRowHint: Write a short, clear description of the product.
description.mainFeaturesHeadingRowHint: Heading for the main features section.
description.featureTextUzPlaceholder: Made from high-quality and environmentally safe materials.
description.featureTextRuPlaceholder: Изготовлено из высококачественных и экологичных материалов.
description.technicalHeadingRowHint: Heading for the technical specifications section.

descriptionImages.title: Description images
descriptionImages.hint: Images shown in the product description section. Upload from your device.
descriptionImages.uploadHint: Click to choose from phone or computer

sizeChart.title: Size chart
sizeChart.intro: The chart and diagram customers use when choosing a size on the product page. Notes under each field explain what to enter.
sizeChart.typeSizeHint: How the product is measured: footwear, upper body clothing, or pants. The matching measurement diagram appears on the site.
sizeChart.titleUzHint: Main name customers see. e.g.: «Footwear size chart».
sizeChart.titleRuHint: The same title for Russian-speaking customers.
sizeChart.instructionRowHint: Explain in plain language how to choose a size — e.g. measure foot length and find the matching number in the chart.
sizeChart.instructionUzHint: Short guide shown above or beside the chart.
sizeChart.instructionUzPlaceholder: Measure foot length and select the matching EU size from the chart.
sizeChart.instructionRuHint: The same instruction for Russian-speaking customers.
sizeChart.instructionRuPlaceholder: Измерьте длину стопы и выберите соответствующий размер EU в таблице.
sizeChart.columnsDesc: Enter the numbers in the chart here. The first column is always «Size» (S, M, L or 36, 37, 38). Add names like height, chest width to other columns.
sizeChart.fixedColumnNote: This column name is fixed — customers see «Size» in the chart. No need to change it.
sizeChart.columnNameUzHint: How this column appears in the chart. e.g.: Height, Chest width.
sizeChart.valuesHintFixed: Enter one size per row: 36, 37, S, M, L, etc. Use «Add more» to add another size.
sizeChart.valuesHintExtra: Numbers in this column. Enter a matching value for each size in the first column (e.g. height: 22.5, 23, 24).
sizeChart.guideDesc: Diagram showing customers where to measure. The site adds an image matching the selected product type — here you only enter the diagram name (optional).
sizeChart.guideNameUzHint: e.g. «Foot measurement». May not appear as a separate heading on the site in most cases.

relatedGroups.title: Style ideas
relatedGroups.intro: Shown on the product page in the «wear together» or style ideas block. Each group is a separate style direction (e.g. lower body, footwear).
relatedGroups.noProducts: You have no other products to link yet. Add at least one product first.
relatedGroups.empty: No groups yet. Click «Add another group».
relatedGroups.titleRowHint: Explains the style direction to customers. e.g.: «Lower body» or «Ideal combination».
relatedGroups.titleUzHint: Style idea heading — the name customers see.
relatedGroups.titleRuHint: The same name for Russian-speaking customers.
relatedGroups.linkedProductsHint: Maximum {{max}} products per group. Only products from your shop appear — other sellers' products are not shown.
relatedGroups.productHint: Click the input — only your products open below. Select by ID and name.

colors.title: Colors and stock
colors.intro: If the product comes in multiple colors, enter separate stock and images for each color. For a single color or no color selection, fill stock in the Product stock section above. For multiple colors — sizeStock for clothing, modelStock for phone models, storageStock for storage. If only color selection applies (no size, model, or storage) — fill the quantity field for each color.
colors.empty: No colors yet. Click «Add another color».
colors.nameRowHint: Color name customers see — e.g. Green, Yellow.
colors.nameUzHint: Color name shown on the product page.
colors.colorFilterHint: For color search on the site. Select from the list — not typed manually.
colors.quantityRowHint: For products with color selection only. Hidden when size, model, or storage is added.
colors.colorQuantityHint: How many units of this color are available. Used when size, model, or storage is not filled.
colors.sizeStockDesc: For clothing and sized products. Each row: size (S, M, L, 38…) and quantity. Leave empty if sold by phone model.
colors.quantityHint: How many units of this size are available.
colors.modelStockDesc: For phones, tablets, and products sold by model name. Each row: model name (S20, A30…), quantity, and prices for that model. Not needed for clothing.
colors.modelStockEmpty: No model rows. Click «Add more» — e.g. S20, S24 ULTRA.
colors.modelHint: Model name. e.g.: S20, A30, S24 ULTRA.
colors.modelQuantityHint: How many units of this model are available.
colors.originalPriceHint: Strikethrough old price if there is a discount.
colors.storageStockDesc: For phones sold by storage capacity. Each row: storage combination (12/256 — RAM/GB), quantity, and prices. Leave empty if sold by clothing or model.
colors.storageStockEmpty: No storage rows. Click «Add more» — e.g. 12/256, 8/128.
colors.storageQuantityHint: How many units of this storage variant are available.
colors.storagePriceHint: Sale price for this storage variant.
colors.priceRowHint: For clothing (sizeStock) products, the general price per color goes here. If modelStock or storageStock is used, price is entered per row — this field is optional.
colors.colorPriceHint: Price customers see when selecting this color.
colors.mainImageHint: Main image shown when the customer selects this color.
colors.thumbnailsHint: Additional images shown when this color is selected.

saveBar.hintCreate: Review the data and save the product — it will appear on the customer site.
saveBar.hintEdit: Save changes — they will update on the customer site.

validation.titleRequired: Title (UZ and RU) must be filled in
validation.countryCodeRequired: Product country of origin must be selected
validation.productCountryRequired: Country of manufacture must be selected
validation.mainImageRequired: Main image must be uploaded (or add at least one color)
validation.chegirmaPercentRequired: Discount label selected — percentage must be entered
validation.discountBothLanguages: Discount text must be filled in both languages
validation.colorDiscountBothLanguages: Color #{{index}}: discount text must be filled in both languages
